{"notes": "VISIT 3 (ended 5:15). Picture: nose is now joined (top and bottom lines both dark to about (25,10)). Both tail lobes at the left are dark and connected. The fin is attached to the top line and dark, except the tip domino near (13.4, 4.8), which is still pale and disconnected. I can't tell who placed what, so I'm not crediting anyone for the build itself.

Tom: Reported the stray problem and the fin-tip fault clearly and openly, and said he was nudging it into line. Good ownership. His earlier joint check seems to have worked, since the fin is attached. But at 5:15 the tip still isn't catching, so his fix hasn't landed yet. Check whether it is resolved before the push.

Leo: Said body and tail are all connected, which matches the picture, apart from the fin tip he flagged himself. He gave a sensible 'hands off the body' instruction before the push. The tail he took at visit 2 is now visible and connected. Clear, accurate status reporting and good team coordination. Leadership is emerging.

Priya: Not seen or heard this visit, and I still can't say who owns the nose join. Her early planning (visit 1) was strong, but I have no evidence of her role since then. Ask her what she did.

Maya: Silent for a third visit, with no visible evidence of contribution. I won't rate her impact without asking. Ask her directly what she built.

NEXT: Check the fin tip is connected before the push, and ask Priya and Maya for their contributions."}
